title: LibreCrawl
author: Marcus Quinn <marcus@marcusquinn.com>
description: Self-hosted website crawler for SEO audits, with a web interface and REST API. Only trusted, operator-created accounts can sign in. Crawling can reach private networks; do not give access to untrusted users.
tagline: Website crawling and SEO audits for trusted teams
postInstallMessage: Sign in as `admin`. Read the generated password in the app terminal with `cat /app/data/admin-password`, or use `cloudron exec --app ${CLOUDRON_APP_DOMAIN} -- cat /app/data/admin-password`. Change it after signing in using `librecrawl-user reset-password admin`. See docs/README.md for stdin-based account administration. Registration and guest access are disabled. WARNING: trusted users can crawl private addresses, other apps and the Docker network. Create accounts only for trusted operators and sites.
